598:t_1:3.en: ～ $$シャイアン基地$$ Underground: Colony Laser Control Room ～

598:t_1:4.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...It seems our trump-card strike force was defeated by $c.」

598:t_1:5.en:
$$ローナン$$
「So the power of this so-called $$バンシィ$$ the Foundation provided wasn't enough, either.」

598:t_1:6.en:
$$アルベルト$$
($$ローナン・マーセナス$$ doesn't know that the $$バンシィ$$'s pilot is his own son, Ensign $$リディ$$...)

598:t_1:7.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(Then again, if he knew, he probably couldn't go through with something like this...)

598:t_1:8.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Those were only scouts, in the end... The real prize is the $$コロニーレーザー$$ the $$宇宙革命軍$$ prepared during the $$多元戦争$$...」

598:t_1:9.en:
$$ローナン$$
「That it can still be operated is a fact known only to people connected with $$クロノ$$.」

598:t_1:10.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Judging by their course, $c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ appear to be heading for $$インダストリアル７$$.」

598:t_1:11.en:
$$マーサ$$
「In other words, that's where the Box is...」

598:t_1:12.en:
$$ローナン$$
「If the two sides get locked in a melee, all the better. We'll dispose of the Box and the nuisances together with the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

598:t_1:13.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「...Are you truly sure that is the right thing to do?」

598:t_1:14.en:
$$ローナン$$
「What are you trying to say?」

598:t_1:15.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Whether a thing like this will really be a plus for humanity's future is highly doubtful.」

598:t_1:16.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Losing $c would mean losing the ones who protect the dignity of Earth's people...」

598:t_1:19.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Get some rest, $$アルベルト$$. ...That's an order.」

598:t_1:21.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...I'm sorry you had to see that.」

598:t_1:22.en:
$$ローナン$$
「I hear he had been acting together with $c.」

598:t_1:23.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Yes... And because of that, he seems to have started harboring needless fantasies.」

598:t_1:24.en:
$$ローナン$$
「...The same as $$リディ$$ once was, then...」

598:t_1:25.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I admire your skill, Chairman, in setting your son straight after that.」

598:t_1:26.en:
$$ローナン$$
「I merely... did what a father ought to do.」

598:t_1:28.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Come to think of it, what did the $$キング$$ say about this operation?」

598:t_1:29.en:
$$ローナン$$
「He has told me he leaves everything to me. That man is no longer anything more than a presence that quietly watches events unfold.」

598:t_1:30.en:
$$マーサ$$
「In that case... a change in $$クロノ$$'s supreme leadership is possible too.」

598:t_1:31.en:
$$ローナン$$
「It's not impossible. The $$キング$$ has lost his successor.」

598:t_1:33.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Depending on how things go, my son may become the new $$キング$$.」

598:t_1:34.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Succession by bloodline... The reason $$クロノ$$ has kept its secrets to this day must be the bond of that blood.」

598:t_1:35.en:
$$ローナン$$
(Where are you, $$リディ$$...? Soon the world will belong wholly to the $$サイデリアル$$.)

598:t_1:36.en:
$$ローナン$$
(To ensure the survival of the species called Earth humanity, there is no end of things I need you to do for $$クロノ$$...)

598:t_1:38.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(You were my light... As long as I had you, I could bear even this wretched way of living...)

598:t_1:39.en:
$$アルベルト$$
(And yet... and yet you...)

598:t_1:40.en:
$$マーサ$$
「What are you doing, $$アルベルト$$? If you're feeling unwell...」

598:t_1:41.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「You...! Didn't you people feel anything?! When her life was scattered!」

598:t_1:43.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You seem tired, $$アルベルト$$. Go and rest.」

598:t_1:44.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Not before I say what I have to say! What you are trying to do is wrong!」

598:t_1:45.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Firing the $$コロニーレーザー$$ from this Earth to bury $c and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in one stroke...! If you do that, humanity's future...」

598:t_1:46.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Get some rest, $$アルベルト$$. ...That's an order.」

598:t_1:49.en:
$$マーサ$$
「...I'm sorry you had to see that.」

598:t_1:50.en:
$$ローナン$$
「Think nothing of it. Even I am aware that what I'm doing is a petty, makeshift move.」

598:t_1:51.en:

598:t_1:55.en:

「If the two sides get locked in a melee, all the better. We'll dispose of the Box and the nuisances together with the $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

598:t_1:56.en:
$$マーサ$$
「With this, even that $c is finished.」

598:t_1:57.en:

598:t_1:71.en:

598:t_1:76.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「$$プトレマイオス２$$... has gone on ahead.」

598:t_1:77.en:
$$レイアム$$
「They'll use $$トランザム$$ to gain all the distance they can, and only then send out the $$ユニコーン$$...」

598:t_1:78.en:
$$オットー$$
「It's as good as using all of $c as decoys. It's bound to succeed.」

598:t_1:79.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$インダストリアル７$$... Is that where it will all be settled...?」

598:t_1:80.en:
$$オットー$$
「That place was also where it all began... Come to think of it, my association with you, Captain, dates back to that time.」

598:t_1:81.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I never imagined I'd meet the end of it on the bridge of this ship.」

598:t_1:83.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...If it hadn't been $$バナージ$$ riding the $$ユニコーン$$, I don't think things would have turned out like this.」

598:t_1:85.en:
$$オットー$$
「And now they are about to fulfill their mission, to put an end to everything.」

uncertain: 598:t_1:3: caption uses tokens + plain 'Underground: Colony Laser Control Room'; colony laser token is lowercase so it reads 'colony laser' in a caption
598:t_1:5 etc: bare 財団 = 'the Foundation' (Vist Foundation inferred, no token used); bare 箱 = 'the Box' (Laplace's Box, plain capitalised, rows 11/12/54/55)
598:t_1:22/57/58: 彼 / アルベルト君 = Alberto; rendered 'he' (Alberto male per glossary, scene settles it)
598:t_1:25: 議長 = 'Chairman' (Ronan, no earlier rendering in corpus)
598:t_1:29/31/33: キング = 'the $$キング$$' (Chrono's king, male per glossary); あの方 = 'That man'
598:t_1:80: キャプテン = 'you, Captain' (Zinnerman addressed by Otto); could be read as third person
598:t_1:77: subject of 'use Trans-Am and then send out the Unicorn' taken as Ptolemaios 2 (continuing row 76)
598:t_1:78: $cを全てオトリに使う read as 'as good as using all of $c as decoys' (plan description, not an order)
rows 52-71 are a repeat/branch of 9-36 with identical Japanese; kept identical English except row 57 (Ronan names Alberto)
